name: Taste of Happiness
original_name: 幸せのスープはいかが？
overview: In Hong Kong, Lam Mei Lan is determined to hold onto her grandfather's noodle shop despite plans for redevelopment in the area. She meets Tao Tetsuya, a from Tokyo who is supposed to be looking after a friend's cats in the apartment opposite hers who offers to help and between them they search for the secret to the best fish ball noodle soup.
